mainEntity.name: Does Stellar manage Hyde Park high-rise condominium buildings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our high-rise program covers building systems, staff and vendor coordination, life-safety and inspection calendars, resident operations, emergency response, monthly financial reporting, and long-range capital planning.

mainEntity.name: Can Stellar help a Hyde Park association plan facade, riser, roof, or elevator work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We coordinate reserve-study inputs, develop a phased capital calendar, prepare comparable bid packages, track board approvals, and oversee authorized work. Stellar does not add a separate capital-project planning or management-oversight fee.

mainEntity.name: What does Hyde Park association management cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customized flat-fee management starts at $20 per unit per month. The proposal reflects the building's size, systems, staffing, amenities, financial complexity, meeting needs, and final service scope.

mainEntity.name: Does Stellar Property Management serve Hyde Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Stellar Property Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Hyde Park, Chicago (ZIP 60615, 60637), backed by a Chicago office that has served area communities since 2007 — 29 associations and approximately 1,422 residences under management, with a 96% client retention rate since 2007.

mainEntity.name: What types of community associations does Stellar manage in Hyde Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar's association-management model is designed for condominiums, high-rises, HOAs, townhomes in Hyde Park. Every client community receives a dedicated property manager, transparent monthly financial reporting, 24/7 live emergency response, and board support informed by applicable Illinois association requirements.

mainEntity.name: How much does association management cost in Hyde Park?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stellar management starts at $20 per unit per month. We quote a customized flat monthly fee based on your Hyde Park association's size, amenities, staffing, financial complexity, and service scope — never a percentage of your budget. We do not add a separate capital-project planning or management-oversight fee. Third-party professional and contractor costs remain association expenses.

mainEntity.name: How do we switch our Hyde Park association to Stellar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switching is a managed 30–60 day transition: once your board signs, we retrieve records from the outgoing firm, migrate banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open your board and resident portals. Call 773.728.0652 or request a proposal online to start.

mainEntity.name: How should a Hyde Park board choose a condo or HOA management company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois management firm license, a credentialed manager (CMCA, AMS or PCAM), a flat monthly fee in writing, who answers emergencies at night, and how records move during the transition. Stellar Property Management is a licensed Chicago firm (license #291000211) that has managed associations since 2007, publishes its pricing, and answers emergencies with a live person 24/7. Boards in Hyde Park can score any proposals side by side with Stellar's free comparison tool at stellarpropertygroup.com/tools/compare-management-proposals.
